_comment: NX-035 repo2: the IAM policy of the DATA_HOST (pgBackRest repo2, journal restic repo2) backup sub-user. Action names and condition as the official TOS example for one bucket and one prefix (docs.volcengine.com 6349/1183391, 2026-10-17): listing is tos:ListBucket on the bucket TRN, limited with StringLike on tos:prefix (lower case); no Version element. tos:HeadBucket lets restic check the bucket exists (no object data). Objects: get, put, delete (pgBackRest expire, restic forget/prune), multipart. No bucket configuration action, no tos:* wildcard. Replace __TOS_BUCKET__ (the name stays in the private env).
